newsitem.title: UK: RMC half-year profits slump, in line with warning.
newsitem.headline: RMC half-year profits slump, in line with warning.

text.p: British building materials giant RMC Group Plc lived up to its stark spring profit warning and turned in half-year profits 26.5 percent lower than last time, also flagging that final figures would not match a record 1995.

Pretax profits for the six months ended June 30 were down to 95.8 million pounds ($149.3 million). Turnover was also lower at 2.11 billion stg, down five percent, but the dividend rose almost five percent to 7.8 pence. The second half figures should be "satisfactory" but the full year is unlikely to match the record 1995 level, RMC said.
The first-half results were hit by a combination of poor weather conditions at the start of the year which hampered building projects and weak markets, including Germany.
Market prospects for the rest of the year were "mixed", with the UK seen benefiting from a recovery in the housing market and growth in commercial property development.
But RMC said "the continuing level of low infrastructure expenditure is a cause for concern".
Demand in Germany is expected to be below 1995 levels, but better than in the first half. France remains tough, but improvements are seen continuing in the U.S. and Israel.
